app.name: WiiStation BindTilt
app.short_description: PSX Emulator with Wiimote Tilt Steering
app.long_description:
WiiStation BindTilt - A Sony PlayStation 1 emulator for Wii / Wii U, featuring a new Wiimote Tilt Steering mode designed for racing games!
New in this fork: - Wiimote Tilt Steering: Hold the Wiimote horizontally and tilt left/right to steer. - Fully customizable deadzone and max tilt angles per profile. - Square-root analog response curve for fine control near the center.
Original Features: - Dynamic recompiler (dynarec) Lightrec. - CDDA (Compact Disc Digital Audio) tracks support. - 240p & Interlaced (480i) modes. - Lightgun and Multitap support. - Multiple languages support. - Support for GameCube, Wii U Pro, Wii Classic, and HID controllers.
* WiiSX/CubeSX is a PCSX port. The original team was: emu_kidid - general coding sepp256 - graphics and menu tehpola - audio * Later updates by: matguitarist Daxtsu Mystro256 FIX94 NiuuS xjsxjs197 saulfabregwiivc Jokippo
